Omnea was founded in 2022 by Ben Freeman and Ben Allen to fix the broken procurement process with a scalable procurement platform.

outcomes.currentStatus: CEO of Omnea, which raised $50M Series B in September 2025 led by Insight Partners and Khosla Ventures (with Accel, Point Nine, First Round, Prosus), bringing total funding to over $75M; revenue grew 5x and headcount tripled in 12 months, with customers including Spotify, Wise, MongoDB, Adecco and Albertsons.
